home.headline: Discover the science behind every plant.
home.subheadline: Identify plant species, explore botanical classification and detect possible plant diseases using AI.
home.specimenCaption: Herbarium & field photography supported · Up to 5 angles per specimen
home.featuresTitle: Botanical analysis powered by PlantScope AI
home.featuresSubtitle: PlantScope AI separates visual species identification, scientific taxonomic classification, and preliminary pathology screening into transparent scientific stages.

identification.title: Plant Identification
identification.description: Upload 1 to 5 photographs of the same individual plant—leaves, flowers, fruits, or bark—to retrieve ranked species candidates, common names, and match scores.

disease.title: Disease Detection
disease.description: Run optional beta plant pathology screening to surface standardized EPPO pathology codes, model scores, and reference imagery where supported.

classification.title: Scientific Classification
classification.description: Every top candidate is cross-checked against a structured botanical taxonomy backbone to present verified seven-rank taxonomy from Kingdom through Species, plus known synonyms.

howItWorks.title: How a botanical scan works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Select up to five clear JPG or PNG images of a single plant. Optional organ tags improve matching accuracy.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Images are processed in memory by the botanical recognition model and the leading scientific name is resolved into its complete taxonomic hierarchy.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Inspect ranked candidates, seven-rank taxonomy, and optional beta disease screening. Save structured records locally in IndexedDB.

home.privacyNote: Photographs are analyzed in memory and never stored on the server.

scanner.title: Identify a Plant Specimen
scanner.subtitle: Upload clear photographs of one individual plant. Species identification and beta disease screening are clearly separated in your report.
scanner.samePlantNote: All uploaded photographs (maximum 5) must depict the same individual plant.
scanner.dropzoneTitle: Drop plant photographs here, or browse files
scanner.dropzoneFormats: Accepted formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG · Up to 5 images · Max 10 MB each
scanner.diseaseToggleNote: Consumes 1 additional daily scan request. Disease coverage is limited to supported crops and pathologies.
scanner.savePhotoLocalLabel: Save thumbnail locally in browser history
scanner.savePhotoLocalNote: Disabled by default. When enabled, a compressed preview stays only in your browser's IndexedDB.
scanner.processingStage: Analyzing specimen imagery and botanical taxonomy...

quota.title: Daily Scan Allowance
quota.exhaustedDesc: Scanning is temporarily paused because the daily request allowance has been reached. Quota resets daily.
quota.unconfiguredDesc: Configure the server identification API key in your backend environment to enable live botanical scans.

validation.invalidType: "{{name}}" is not a supported format. Only JPG, JPEG, and PNG images are accepted.
validation.maxImages: You can upload a maximum of 5 photographs of the same plant per scan.
validation.noImages: Select at least one plant photograph before running analysis.

overview.lowConfidenceBannerDesc: The top identification score is below 35%. Do not treat this as a confirmed botanical identification. Consider adding clearer images of leaves, flowers, or fruit from the same specimen.
overview.noCandidatesDesc: The identification model did not return a matching plant species for the submitted photographs.
overview.hindiFallbackNote: Species metadata is displayed in English because Hindi localization is not available for this record. Scientific Latin names are preserved.

taxonomy.title: Scientific Taxonomic Classification
taxonomy.subtitle: Structured seven-rank botanical classification. Scientific names remain in their canonical Latin form.
taxonomy.unverified: Full taxonomic verification unavailable — showing confirmed ranks only
taxonomy.noSynonyms: No taxonomic synonyms recorded for this species.

disease.title: Plant Disease Analysis (Beta)
disease.betaNotice: Plant Disease Identification is a beta model with limited plant species and pathology coverage. It is not an all-species diagnostic tool.
disease.disclaimerBody: AI disease predictions are preliminary and must not replace inspection by a qualified plant pathologist or agricultural extension officer, especially where serious crop damage is suspected. PlantScope AI does not fabricate symptoms, causes, or chemical treatment dosages.

not_requested.title: Disease analysis was not enabled for this scan
not_requested.desc: Enable "Include Plant Disease Analysis (Beta)" on the scanner page to screen supported crop and plant pathologies (uses 1 additional scan request).

possible_disease_detected.title: Possible disease detected
possible_disease_detected.desc: The beta pathology model returned candidate disease matches below. Review model scores and EPPO codes carefully.

no_supported_match.title: No supported disease match
no_supported_match.desc: The pathology model did not return a supported disease prediction for these images. This does not confirm the plant is healthy.

inconclusive.title: Inconclusive result
inconclusive.desc: The submitted photographs or supported disease model coverage were insufficient for a reliable pathology assessment.

unavailable.title: Disease analysis unavailable
unavailable.desc: The disease identification request did not complete, while your plant species identification remains intact.

disease.author: Author
disease.noDescription: No description supplied for this pathology prediction.

notFound.title: Scan result not found
notFound.desc: This scan result is no longer in active session memory or local browser history.

history.title: Local Scan History
history.subtitle: Saved botanical identifications stored privately in your browser's IndexedDB. No photographs are stored on the server.
history.searchPlaceholder: Search by common or scientific name...
history.clearConfirmDesc: This permanently removes all {{count}} saved scan record(s) from this browser's IndexedDB storage.
history.emptyDesc: Run a plant identification and save the report to build your local botanical reference log.

about.title: About PlantScope AI
about.subtitle: A botanical identification, scientific taxonomy, and preliminary plant pathology workbench built with open-source technology.
about.plantnetDesc: Analyzes one to five multi-angle photographs of leaves, flowers, fruits, or bark to return ranked botanical species candidates, match scores, and optional beta pathology screening with standardized EPPO codes.
about.gbifDesc: Resolves each leading scientific name into its complete seven-rank taxonomic hierarchy—from Kingdom through Species—along with taxonomic status and known botanical synonyms.
limitations: Plant identification scores are probabilistic visual matches, not confirmed laboratory determinations.
Disease detection is a beta feature with limited species and pathology coverage; absence of a match does not mean a plant is healthy.
PlantScope AI never fabricates taxonomy ranks, symptoms, causes, or pesticide dosages.
Uploaded photographs are validated in server memory and discarded immediately after analysis.
about.privacyDesc: All scan history and language preferences are persisted exclusively in your local browser via IndexedDB and localStorage. No accounts or logins are required.
about.setupHint: Configure the server identification API key in your backend environment to run live plant scans.

errors.API_KEY_NOT_CONFIGURED: The identification service key is not configured on the server. Add it to your server environment to run live scans.
errors.INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT: One or more files are not valid JPG, JPEG, or PNG images.
errors.TOO_MANY_IMAGES: You can upload a maximum of 5 photographs per scan.
errors.NO_IMAGES: Please select at least one plant photograph.
errors.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: One of the selected images exceeds the 10 MB per-image limit.
errors.REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: Total upload size exceeds the 25 MB limit.
errors.INVALID_REQUEST: The request or image could not be processed (HTTP 400). Try another clear photograph.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: The configured identification service key was rejected (HTTP 401). Please check your server configuration.
